optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Supply Chain Collaboration
professionalSummary: Planned onboarding projects for twenty-three suppliers across two manufacturer customers, maintaining the milestone schedule (connectivity test, mapping sign-off, parallel run, go-live) for each supplier in the programme tracker. (src_c0f78ab513bc)
Tracked integration milestones with three integration engineers, updating supplier status in the tracker each week and raising slipped milestones in the weekly project review. (src_eb0843d19ade)

Reduced average supplier onboarding time from 46 days to 29 days across seventeen suppliers after introducing standard mapping templates, as recorded against the baseline of 46 days for the first six suppliers. (src_ad00f04feb4b)

Coordinated onboarding decisions with the programme lead and customer operations, with the programme lead deciding supplier sequencing and customer operations confirming each go-live. (src_f33fb7043a94)
Authored completion notes for each onboarded supplier, documenting open mapping limitations and hand-over points for the support team. (src_eda41dc63db0)
experienceHighlights: Planned onboarding projects for twenty-three suppliers across two manufacturer customers, maintaining milestone schedules in the programme tracker. (src_c0f78ab513bc)

Reduced average onboarding time from 46 to 29 days across seventeen suppliers after template introduction, recorded against baseline. (src_ad00f04feb4b)
Coordinated onboarding decisions with programme lead and customer operations, confirming go-live sequencing. (src_f33fb7043a94)
Wrote completion notes listing limitations and hand-over points for each supplier. (src_eda41dc63db0)
